metadata.title: Order import batch and open-orders API
metadata.author: AA

prerequisites: utPLSQL installed on the target database
Connected as #APP# on the TEST environment
launch.notes: Run from SQLcl. Use the documentation reporter for a readable output.

test_cases.title: Open orders returned only for the given customer
test_cases.preconditions: Fixture: customer 1 with one OPEN and one CANCELLED order

test_cases.title: Null customer id raises a business exception
Front end lists only open orders for the selected customer
test_cases.preconditions: Test user logged in; customer 1 selected
test_cases.steps: Open the orders panel and read the list

control_queries.description: No invalid objects in #APP# after deploy
control_queries.sql: select object_name, object_type from all_objects where owner = '#APP#' and status <> 'VALID'

control_queries.description: No orders without a matching customer
control_queries.sql: select o.order_id from #APP#.orders o where not exists (select 1 from #APP#.customers c where c.customer_id = o.customer_id)

control_queries.description: Order header total equals the sum of its lines
control_queries.sql: select o.order_id from #APP#.orders o join #APP#.order_lines l on l.order_id = o.order_id group by o.order_id, o.total_amount having o.total_amount <> sum(l.line_amount)

control_queries.description: No errors logged by the ORDER_IMPORT batch today
control_queries.sql: select logged_at, error_code, error_message from #APP#.log_errors where process_name = 'ORDER_IMPORT' and logged_at >= trunc(sysdate)
